entities.name: covenant
entities.description: A formal agreement or contract that outlines specific rules or restrictions, often related to property use or development, such as building restrictions or neighborhood rules.

entities.name: expansion
entities.description: The process of increasing the size, scope, or capacity of a school or other institution, often involving approval processes and documentation to ensure compliance with regulations.

entities.name: enrollment
entities.description: The number of students registered or enrolled in a school or educational program, used to monitor capacity and compliance with agreements.

entities.name: neighborhood issues
entities.description: Problems or concerns raised by residents within a neighborhood, including development, infrastructure, safety, and environmental issues.

entities.name: swale package
entities.description: A set of plans or documents related to the installation and maintenance of swales, which are landscape elements designed to manage stormwater runoff and improve drainage.

entities.name: public safety
entities.description: Measures and policies aimed at protecting residents from harm, including law enforcement, fire safety, and emergency response.

entities.name: drop-off and pick-up
entities.description: Procedures and arrangements for the safe and efficient dropping off and picking up of students or residents, often related to schools or community facilities.

entities.name: traffic congestion
entities.description: The overcrowding of vehicles on roads, leading to slow movement and delays, often addressed through traffic management and infrastructure improvements.
